item.title: Legal Action Begins After Deadly UPS MD-11 Freighter Crash
item.description: The families of several victims killed in last month’s UPS Airlines MD-11 freighter crash are preparing to file wrongful death lawsuits against multiple companies. Reports indicate that the suit accuses UPS of negligence and also lists GE Aerospace, maker of the aircraft’s engines, and Boeing, which inherited responsibility for the MD-11 after acquiring McDonnell Douglas.
